t480399108: Art. 67 of Law 14,133/2021 (Brazil’s Public Procurement Law) addresses technical qualification on two fronts. Professional technical qualification shows that the company has professionals — registered with the relevant professional board where applicable — holding a certificate of technical responsibility for a similar project or service. Operational technical qualification shows that the company itself has already delivered similar services of equal or greater technological and operational complexity, backed by official records or certificates.

t5a581e7d2: Digital certificate or gov.br: the signer downloads the PDF, signs it with an ICP-Brasil certificate (A1 or A3) or with a gov.br signature, and uploads the signed file on the same page. tc63adea6d: Two details in the same article change how these documents should be handled. Under §1º, the requirement is limited to the most significant portions — those worth 4% or more of the estimated total. Under §2º, the tender notice may require minimum quantities of up to 50% of those portions, and limits on time or specific locations are prohibited. In other words: quantities matter, and an old certificate is still valid — as long as you can find it.

t90e3c33f3: An employee witnesses harassment and decides to report it from her phone without identifying herself. During triage, the report names a manager who sits on the committee — and he loses access to the case immediately. Days later, the committee asks for a detail through the case conversation, and she replies, still anonymous.
